he: לְלִיבָּא בְּחַמְרָא, וְסִימָנָךְ ״וְיַיִן יְשַׂמַּח לְבַב אֱנוֹשׁ״. לְרוּחָא בְּמַיָּא, וְסִימָנָךְ ״וְרוּחַ אֱלֹהִים מְרַחֶפֶת עַל פְּנֵי הַמָּיִם״. לְכוּדָא בְּשִׁיכְרָא, וְסִימָנָךְ ״וְכַדָּהּ עַל שִׁכְמָהּ״.
en: This remedy is beneficial for several ailments, and the Gemara presents each of these in turn: For curing the heart, the above combination should be taken with wine, and your mnemonic for this is the verse: “And wine that makes glad the heart of man” (Psalms 104:15). For curing an ailment that arises due to the wind [ruḥa], one drinks the mixture in water, and your mnemonic for this is the verse: “And the spirit [ruaḥ] of God hovered over the face of the waters” (Genesis 1:2). For childbirth [lekhuda], a woman in labor drinks the mixture with beer [shikhra], and your mnemonic for this is the verse: “With her pitcher [vekhadah] upon her shoulder [shikhmah]” (Genesis 24:15).
